WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO support.feedback_replies (feedback_id, direction, from_email, to_email, subject, body, sent_by, sent_at, message_id)
  SELECT f.id, 'in', $2, $3, $4, $5, $2, ($6::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), NULLIF($7, '')
  FROM support.feedback f
  WHERE f.id = $1::int AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) WHERE message_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING feedback_id
)
UPDATE support.feedback f
SET status = 'reviewing', updated_at = now(), updated_by = 'inbound-mail'
FROM ins
WHERE f.id = ins.feedback_id AND f.status = 'replied'
RETURNING f.id
